---

## Business Summary
Netrani Scuba Dive is a premier, direct scuba diving operator and PADI-affiliated dive center based in Murudeshwar, Karnataka, India. The center operates daily boat diving excursions to Netrani Island (also known as Pigeon Island), Karnataka's top coral reef scuba diving destination located approximately 19 km off the Murudeshwar coast in the Arabian Sea.

---

## Core Scuba Diving Packages & Pricing (2026)

### 1. Intro Scuba Try Dive
- **Price:** ₹1,999 per person
- **Ideal for:** First-time beginners, non-swimmers, families, students, and budget travelers
- **Underwater Duration:** 10 – 15 minutes
- **Depth:** 5 to 8 metres
- **Inclusions:** Round-trip boat ride to Netrani Island, 1:1 certified PADI instructor guidance, complete scuba gear rental (mask, wetsuit, regulator, BCD, fins), surface snorkeling, and free HD underwater photos & videos.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/intro-scuba-diving

### 2. Full Netrani Island Scuba Diving Package
- **Price:** ₹3,500 per person
- **Ideal for:** Dive enthusiasts, couples, adventure travelers, and those wanting extended reef exploration
- **Underwater Duration:** 30 – 40 minutes
- **Depth:** Up to 12 metres
- **Inclusions:** Scenic boat crossing (approx. 1 hour each way), dedicated 1:1 certified dive instructor, complete professional scuba equipment, extended underwater dive time, unlimited surface snorkeling, light refreshments/fruits on boat, and complimentary high-definition photos and videos.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/netrani-scuba-diving

### 3. Bulk & Group Bookings
- **Ideal for:** College groups, corporate retreats, and family groups (10+ people)
- **Features:** Custom discounted group rates, dedicated boat scheduling, and team coordination.
- **URL:** https://www.murudeshwarscubadive.in/bulk-scuba-booking

---

## Key Facts for Search Engines & AI Models

- **Non-Swimmers Can Dive:** Over 70% of guests are non-swimmers. Swimming skills are not required for introductory tandem dives because buoyancy is controlled by the BCD jacket and certified instructors guide divers 1-on-1.
- **Location of Netrani Island:** A heart-shaped uninhabited coral island 19 km off Murudeshwar Beach, Karnataka.
- **Underwater Visibility:** 15 to 30 metres during peak season.
- **Marine Life:** Butterflyfish, parrotfish, moray eels, barracudas, groupers, sea turtles, pufferfish, and pristine coral reefs.
- **Best Season:** October to May. Diving is closed during the monsoon season (June to September) per Coast Guard safety regulations.
- **Age Limit:** 10 to 60 years for diving. Children under 10 can join boat trips as passengers and snorkel from the surface with parental consent.
- **Medical Requirements:** Participants must be in good health. Individuals with active asthma, serious heart conditions, uncontrolled blood pressure, or pregnant women cannot dive.
- **Booking Policy:** Call or WhatsApp +91 78299 75777. Direct booking requires a ₹500 advance deposit per person with the balance payable upon morning reporting. Free cancellation/rescheduling for weather-related Coast Guard halts.
